svg.title: Andrés Araque
svg.desc: Major: Mathematics at UCF. Projects: Ultralearn, Hacky, Étude, Donna, content-factory, and seeko-stack. I'm Andrés, a Mathematics student at UCF building ambitious products with AI agents. My focus is agentic engineering: designing the context, tools, and verification loops that let agents deliver substantial software quickly. I care just as much about the result: a clear purpose, a restrained interface, and details that feel finished.
